left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients aged between 18 and 70 years

right.raw_text: -  Using a moderate dose of atorvastatin (40 mg  [OR] or equivalent dose of other statins)

Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients suffering from ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI)
  -  Patients need for immediate cardiac catheterization
  -  Elevated liver enzymes (Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) [OR]  and Alanine aminotransferase (ALT) three times the upper limit of normal)
-  Any contraindication to carvedilol, [OR]  or atorvastatin

left.raw_text: -  Patients on regular use of vitamins, [OR]  minerals

right.raw_text: -  Using medication with antioxidant properties e
, beta-carotene, [OR]  vitamin E, [OR]  vitamin C, [OR]  selenium, [OR]  theophylline  [OR] or N-acetyl cysteine 7 days prior to CC

left.raw_text: -  Hemodynamically unstable patients (defined as abnormal  [OR] or unstable blood pressure, especially hypotension (blood pressure less than 90/60 mm Hg)
-  Using of carvedilol in the past three months

right.raw_text: -  Using a nephrotoxic agent in the past 48 hours  [OR] or exposure to a contrast agent in the past 7 days prior to cardiac catheterization
